note: Close-up of the big wooden market crate in the B61 attic: dove-grey plank wall with oak braces, honey floorboards, light from the left. LANDMARK: the long weathered crate itself, five things on top and five on the floor in front. The strip's Back button returns to the attic. Adjectives have no gender (divider null).
